officialEvidence.coverage: Bangladesh survey-map service; Gaibandha district administrative entry resolved, parcel coverage not established

officialEvidence.observation: Official Department of Land Records and Surveys site describes current survey maps, khatians, map purchase, and khatian/map search services.
Official DLRS map portal describes purchase/search of CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS mouza maps; it is an order/map-product workflow, not evidence of an open parcel vector API.
Official Gaibandha district portal identifies Gaibandha Sadar among the district's upazilas, supporting local administrative scope.
Official Gaibandha settlement-office citizen charter describes land-record and survey-map preparation and access through settlement offices; it does not publish a citywide anonymous geometry service.

blocker: The current public viewer resolved Gaibandha and an ongoing RS/BRS survey but returned no upazila/thana entries for the selected district/survey, preventing anonymous mouza, sheet and parcel geometry lookup. This is an access/coverage limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
